usage: The word '叉燒腸粉' refers to a type of rice noodle roll filled with BBQ pork, commonly eaten as a dim sum dish.
It can be used as a subject or object in a sentence, for example, 'I like 叉燒腸粉' or 'The restaurant serves tasty 叉燒腸粉.'
When ordering food, you can say '我要一份叉燒腸粉' to mean 'I want an order of bbq pork rice noodle roll.'
It typically appears as a noun phrase, describing a particular dish in Cantonese cuisine.
